items.statement: Scheduling, concurrency, deadlines and watchdog policy are outside the deterministic component lifecycle core.
items.feature: Explicit policy adapter boundary and lifecycle result reporting
items.unknown_behavior: Do not imply preemption, thread safety, scheduling or watchdog ownership.
verification: Lifecycle transitions and callback errors are observable.
The caller owns serialization across independent contexts.
Unsupported policy requests return an explicit error.

items.statement: No time budget or deadline is provided to a step callback by the current minimal runtime.
items.unknown_behavior: Do not claim deadline compliance or bounded execution time without an instrumented target adapter.
verification: Timing source is injected by the caller.
Overrun is reported separately from callback success.
No scheduler or timing guarantee is added to the core implicitly.
